title: Story premise ENT115: The Repair Fair’s Little Waiting Chair
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: Everything is waiting in the work area. Takeaway/theme: Separate arrival, work, and collection so status stays visible.
description: A volunteer wants to keep a toy repair fair organized, but people holding broken paper objects crowd the workbench. They create a clear intake tray, a numbered waiting chair, and a visible READY shelf; the final reveal shows one repaired paper bird flying a thank-you tag between all three stations.
